spans.text: [18] AR: إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ EN: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allah a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.

entries.task_id: those|are|[in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs
entries.description: those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs
entries.subject: those
entries.object: [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs

spans.text: [19] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ EN: And those who have believed in Allah and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord.

entries.task_id: for them|is|their reward and their light
entries.description: For them is their reward and their light
entries.subject: For them

spans.text: For them is their reward and their light.

spans.text: But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.

entries.subject: this world
entries.object: but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example

spans.text: [20] AR: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهْوٌۭ وَزِينَةٌۭ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَٰدِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَٰمًۭا ۖ وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ وَمَغْفِرَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌۭ ۚ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ EN: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example

folded.id: a wall|will|be placed between them with a door
folded.subject: a wall
folded.object: be placed between them with a door

spans.text: And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
But to all Allah has promised the best [reward].
And indeed, Allah is to you Kind and Merciful.

folded.id: among you|are|those who spent before the conquest [of makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]
folded.subject: among you
folded.object: those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]

spans.text: Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it].
He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.

[1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

folded.id: and he|is|with you wherever you are
folded.subject: and He

spans.text: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are.

[6] AR: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ EN: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and he is Knowing of that within the breasts.

[18] AR: إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ EN: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allah a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.

folded.id: and what|has|come down of the truth?
folded.subject: and what

spans.text: [16] AR: ۞ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ EN: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah and what has come down of the truth?
It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination.

folded.id: denied our|verses|- those are the companions of hellfire
folded.subject: denied Our
folded.object: - those are the companions of Hellfire

spans.text: But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.

folded.id: for them|is|their reward and their light
folded.subject: For them

spans.text: For them is their reward and their light.
He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.
[3] AR: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ EN: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.

folded.id: he|knows|what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein
folded.subject: He
folded.object: what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein

spans.text: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are.

folded.id: his|is|the dominion of the heavens and earth
folded.subject: His
folded.object: the dominion of the heavens and earth

spans.text: [2] AR: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ EN: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth.
[5] AR: لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ EN: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth.

folded.id: hypocrite women|will|say to those who believed
folded.subject: hypocrite women

spans.text: [13] AR: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًۭا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍۢ لَّهُۥ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ EN: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light."

folded.id: it|is|he who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established himself above the throne
folded.subject: It
folded.object: He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne

spans.text: [4] AR: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ EN: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne.

folded.id: it|is|he who sends down upon his servant [muhammad] verses of clear evidence that he may bring you out from darknesses into the light
folded.subject: It
folded.object: He who sends down upon His Servant [Muhammad] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light

spans.text: [9] AR: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ EN: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muhammad] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light.
It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination.

[18] AR: إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ EN: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allah a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.
It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light."

[12] AR: يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ EN: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally."

folded.id: no ransom|will|be taken from you or from those who disbelieved
folded.subject: no ransom
folded.object: be taken from you or from those who disbelieved

spans.text: [15] AR: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌۭ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ مَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ هِىَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved.
And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.
We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.

folded.id: that allah|gives|life to the earth after its lifelessness
folded.subject: that Allah
folded.object: life to the earth after its lifelessness

spans.text: [17] AR: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ EN: Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its lifelessness.

folded.id: that we|may|acquire some of your light
folded.subject: that we

spans.text: [13] AR: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًۭا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍۢ لَّهُۥ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ EN: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light."
That is what is the great attainment.
And the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah.

[14] AR: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَٱرْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ EN: The hypocrites will call to the believers, "Were we not with you?"

folded.id: the messenger|invites|you to believe in your lord and he has taken your covenant
folded.subject: the Messenger
folded.object: you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant

spans.text: [8] AR: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ EN: And why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers?
For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward.
They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allah.

folded.id: this world|is|but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example
folded.subject: this world
folded.object: but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example

folded.id: those|are|[in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs
folded.subject: those
folded.object: [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs

spans.text: [19] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ EN: And those who have believed in Allah and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord.

folded.id: those|are|greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought
folded.subject: Those
folded.object: greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought

spans.text: Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought.

folded.id: tidings today|are|[of] gardens beneath which rivers flow
folded.subject: tidings today

spans.text: [12] AR: يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ EN: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally."
And to Allah are returned [all] matters.

folded.id: to allah|belongs|the heritage of the heavens and the earth?
folded.subject: to Allah
folded.object: the heritage of the heavens and the earth?

spans.text: [10] AR: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَٰتَلَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَٰتَلُوا۟ ۚ وَكُلًّۭا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ EN: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allah while to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth?

folded.id: whatever|is|in the heavens and earth exalts allah
folded.subject: Whatever
folded.object: in the heavens and earth exalts Allah

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

[12] AR: يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ EN: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally."

[7] AR: ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ EN: Believe in Allah and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successors.

folded.id: who|is|it that would loan allah a goodly loan so he will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
folded.subject: Who
folded.object: it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?

spans.text: [11] AR: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ EN: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
Your refuge is the Fire.
